label: At D2, high when S1 is reached, strongest after a rare a2-to-S1 transition.
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * prev_reward * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo
explanation: Beyond timing (which alone gives R^2 0.87), the candidate value of unit 13 is set mainly at D2 by the choice x reached-state cell that has just been observed: a2->S1 (rare) is much higher (about +0.9 residual), a1->S1 slightly up, and a1->S2 / a2->S2 lower (a1->S2 rare is the lowest). The three-term short form reproduces that 4-cell D2 table. The free fit adds a small D1 shift (higher after the previous choice was a2, lower after rewarded a1 trials) and a weak negative belief_lo term (higher when the observer believes S2 is good), mostly at D2 and D1. GO is almost entirely timing. Reward and future variables add little.

issues: The label leaves out the low end. The rare a1->S2 cell is the lowest at D2 (residual -0.48), below common a2->S2 (-0.28), so a reader of the label alone cannot rank the S2 outcomes. This is a small wording gap; the short form encodes it correctly.

A moderate systematic miss remains at D2 after a rewarded a1->S1 previous trial. The short form over-predicts by 0.24 there and under-predicts after a1 S2 r (+0.15). The a1->S1 cell also varies widely (actual values from -0.36 to +0.52). Adding (phase==D2)*last_is('a1 S1 r') as a 4th term raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.695 to 0.771, and (phase==D2)*belief_lo raises it to 0.775. This matches the explanation's claim of a negative belief_lo term at D2, but it cannot fit within 3 terms. Swapping the action==2 term for it drops R^2 to 0.664, and belief-based 3-term forms reach only 0.60-0.62.

The D1 claims check out: the residual is about +0.1 after a2 and about -0.12 after rewarded a1 trials. Adding (phase==D1)*(prev_action==2) as a 4th term gives 0.726. The claim that GO is almost entirely timing also holds (GO residuals under 0.04).

The short form's 0.695 trails the 'this choice x state' reference table (0.85). The gap mostly comes from D1 choice/previous-choice effects of about ±0.1, not from a mis-specified D2 description. I found no better 3-term short form: variants using common==0 or belief all scored lower or the same.
skeptic.revised_label: At D2, high when S1 is reached (strongest after rare a2->S1), lowest after rare a1->S2.

final_label: At D2, high when S1 is reached (strongest after rare a2->S1), lowest after rare a1->S2.
